"LA ESPADA CELESTIAL
ENCARGO MAESTRO DEFINITIVO PARA IA GAME LAB
RPG DE FANTASÍA ÉPICA — OBJETIVO: ASPIRAR A GOTY
INSTRUCCIÓN PRINCIPAL:
Quiero que desarrolles LA ESPADA CELESTIAL, un videojuego RPG de fantasía medieval, acción, aventura, exploración y criaturas coleccionables. No quiero una simple demostración, una maqueta, una presentación, una biblia de diseño ni un escenario con botones decorativos. Quiero un videojuego real, jugable, funcional, profundo, original y profesional.
La ambición es crear un título capaz de competir algún día entre los mejores videojuegos del mundo y aspirar al premio GOTY (Game of the Year).
No afirmes que el juego ha ganado o merece un premio sin haberlo conseguido. El GOTY es nuestro objetivo de excelencia, no una promesa.
Debes trabajar sobre las capacidades reales de IA Game Lab, inspeccionar el proyecto existente y utilizar las herramientas disponibles para construir el juego. No inventes funciones que la plataforma no pueda ejecutar. Si algo no es posible, explica la limitación y desarrolla la mejor alternativa técnica.
---
1. IDENTIDAD DEL VIDEOJUEGO
Nombre: LA ESPADA CELESTIAL.
Género: RPG de acción, fantasía medieval, aventura, exploración, combate y colección de criaturas.
Plataforma prioritaria: Android.
Orientación: Horizontal.
Idioma: Español de España.
Estética: Fantasía medieval cinematográfica con personalidad anime, escenarios detallados, iluminación espectacular, personajes originales y efectos visuales de alta calidad.
Inspiración: La profundidad de los grandes RPG, la libertad de exploración de las aventuras clásicas y la emoción de coleccionar criaturas, sin copiar personajes, diseños, música, historias ni propiedades intelectuales existentes.
El juego debe tener identidad propia y ser reconocible por su universo, personajes, criaturas, música y dirección artística.
---
2. OBJETIVO DE CALIDAD: NIVEL GOTY
Diseña y desarrolla el juego siguiendo estándares de excelencia en:
Jugabilidad.
Combate.
Historia.
Personajes.
Mundo.
Exploración.
Diseño artístico.
Música y sonido.
Animaciones.
Inteligencia artificial.
Interfaz y controles.
Rendimiento.
Accesibilidad.
Profundidad de sistemas.
Originalidad.
Cada sistema debe aportar algo al conjunto.
No quiero cantidad sin calidad.
No quiero un mundo enorme vacío, enemigos repetidos, misiones genéricas ni habilidades que no tengan utilidad.
Quiero una experiencia memorable.
---
3. UNIVERSO E HISTORIA
El mundo está formado por regiones conectadas por una historia épica.
Región inicial: VALDORIA
Una tierra de aldeas, bosques, praderas, ríos, montañas, ruinas y antiguas civilizaciones.
Aquí comienza la aventura.
Región de DRAKMOR
Territorios volcánicos, fortalezas, ciudades devastadas, bosques oscuros y criaturas corrompidas.
Región de KANSORDORE
Templos celestiales, ciudades antiguas, bibliotecas prohibidas, dimensiones alternativas y misterios relacionados con el origen del mundo.
Elementos fundamentales de la historia
La Gema Celestial.
La Jarra de Origen.
La Lágrima de la Primera Brasa.
La Profecía de Jugador Cero.
La Convergencia Absoluta.
El Despertar.
La Resonancia.
El Velo.
La Ruptura.
La Ascensión.
Construye una historia original, coherente y emocionante, con misterios, revelaciones, conflictos, decisiones, consecuencias, personajes memorables y un final satisfactorio.
No reveles todos los misterios al principio.
La historia debe desarrollarse mediante acontecimientos jugables, diálogos, exploración y escenas cinematográficas.
---
4. PROTAGONISTA
Crear un protagonista personalizable.
Permitir configurar, según las posibilidades técnicas:
Nombre.
Rostro.
Pelo.
Color de pelo.
Ropa.
Armadura.
Casco.
Accesorios.
Armas.
Estadísticas
Vida.
Maná.
Resistencia.
Fuerza.
Defensa.
Velocidad.
Inteligencia.
Suerte.
Cada atributo debe tener efectos medibles.
El equipamiento debe modificar las estadísticas y, cuando sea viable, la apariencia del personaje.
Crear animaciones diferenciadas de reposo, caminar, correr, atacar, esquivar, bloquear, recibi
"

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

# Worker Agents Skills

This repository bundles the baseline skills installed by [Worker
Agents](https://github.com/agents-dev/workerAgents).

The bundled skills are available under [`skills/`](skills/):

- `mcp-duckgo` — imported from `aahl/skills@mcp-duckgo`.
- `image-search` — imported from `z0gsh1u/oh-my-writing-skill@image-search`.
- `gauntlet-loop` — imported from `robonuggets/gauntlet-loop@gauntlet-loop`.
- `load-sketchfab-threejs` — local asset inspection, normalization, and Three.js/PlayCanvas A/B viewer skill.
- `opencode-zen-completions` — use the OpenCode Zen chat completions API for implementation work.

The original upstream licenses are preserved in
[`third-party-licenses/`](third-party-licenses/).
---
name: OpenCode
run-name: "OpenCode #${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}${{ github.event.issue.title && format(' — {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: Existing issue to run
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: opencode-issue-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event.action == 'opened' && contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'OpenCode'))
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-prepare.yml@3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2
    with:
      runtime_ref: 3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2

  opencode:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.approved == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
      pull-requests: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-reusable.yml@3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2
    with:
      runtime_ref: 3b460fef6b0cbee61ae301726c8a54b00b73bfd2
      issue_number: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_number }}
      request: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.request }}
      issue_title: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_title }}
      labels_json: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.labels_json }}
      sender: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sender }}
      target_ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_ref }}
      target_sha: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_sha }}
    secrets:
      OPENCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
      OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON }}
      AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY: ${{ secrets.AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY }}
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}

# OMG (Oh My GitHub) agent instructions

Do not implement, suggest, report, or propose security issues unless the user explicitly asks for a security review.
Inspect the OpenCode implementation at `/Users/igor/Documents/ChatGPT/opencode` and [anomalyco/opencode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode) for related requests.

## Wiki index

- [OpenCode workflow](wiki/opencode.md)
- [Test OpenCode execution](wiki/opencode-v2-experiment.md)
- [Oh My Github App](https://github.com/denaidark/omsite/blob/main/wiki/oh-my-github-app.md)
- [Temporary Mac SSH access](wiki/access.md)
- [Testing and verification](wiki/testing.md)
- [OmGithub publishing](https://github.com/denaidark/omsite/blob/main/wiki/omgithub.md)


## Main project file

The main project file is [.github/workflows/opencode.yml](.github/workflows/opencode.yml).

Keep the local [game issue E2E skill](.agents/skills/game-issue-e2e/SKILL.md)
aligned with this workflow. Create an issue with `OpenCode` and only user-requested mode labels already attached, to start the native `issues.opened` listener. Wait only for the
initial OpenCode session link during E2E kickoff. Install the listener on the
default branch before requesting execution. Validate author access and freeze
the request inside Actions before starting the reusable execution job.
Set repository variable `OPENCODE_ACCESS=everyone` to accept any issue author
for labeled issues. Keep the App as a setup
helper. Use Actions concurrency to serialize each issue.
Store `branch` in an `omgithub-request:v1` JSON HTML comment to select the
project checkout, result base, and workflow. Let default-branch preparation
dispatch the selected branch. Run preparation and OpenCode in that branch run.

## Shell timing

When writing shell scripts,
always add explicit per-command execution-time measurements between commands.
Use `/usr/bin/time -p` or a small timing helper around each meaningful command;
the outer command duration is not sufficient because it hides which step is
slow or hung. Use `/usr/bin/time` only in scripts; do not invoke it directly in
interactive shell commands.

## Ideas

Store durable implementation ideas as individual Markdown files under
`./ideas/`, using descriptive kebab-case filenames such as
`ideas/opencode-oauth-env-auth.md`.




## Links in handoffs

When a relevant URL or stable identifier exists, include a clickable Markdown
link in the user-facing response. Link GitHub issues, Actions runs, pull
requests, commits, releases, public app URLs, and Codex tasks/threads rather
than reporting only their numbers or plain text. For Codex tasks/threads, use
the `codex://threads/<thread-id>` URL format.

When mentioning a commit, append its relative age in hours or days.

## OpenCode GitHub Actions

To execute an issue, create it with `OpenCode` and only mode labels explicitly requested by the user.
Check for a native `issues` run and successful preparation.
The workflow starts a temporary AgentsWeb SSH session,
verifies it, runs OpenCode, and cleans up the SSH session afterward.

When monitoring a triggered run, use `gh run watch <run-id> --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub --exit-status` for overall job status.
Do not use `gh run view --log` to read logs from a running task: GitHub reports that
logs are unavailable until completion. Use `bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id>`
for the live Actions log over SSH. Do not use tight `for` loops around `gh run list`,
which needlessly consume GitHub API rate limit.

Free OpenCode models are limited per egress IP, not per account.
Treat a local `FreeUsageLimitError` 429 as local only.
Read the runner's own `Selected model` and provider errors before blaming quota.
Use `retryAfterMs` as the reset bound.
Run repeated V2 tests with a connected provider; do not spend the free allowance on retries.

Interrupting a V2 turn before the assistant message projects leaves no stopped message to save.
Wait for that assistant message before requiring the interrupted idle marker.

To connect to an issue's live worker, find its run ID with
`gh run list --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub --workflow opencode.yml --status in_progress`,
then run `bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id>` to discover the host and port and SSH
with `~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb` as shown by the helper.

When the user asks to check a live OpenCode workflow, always pull the runner logs
over SSH first, using `scripts/ssh-run-log.sh` or a targeted SSH read from the
same runner. Base the answer on those logs before discussing whether an action
is confirmed; do not lead with a generic inability-to-confirm statement when
live log evidence can be collected.

For real-time inspection from a live temporary SSH session, use the helper:

```sh
bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id>
```

The helper discovers the temporary SSH command from the triggering issue or pull
request, then follows the freshest `_diag/pages` log. The runner uploads chunks from
`_diag/blocks` to GitHub. Do not print environment files, tokens, or private keys while
inspecting the runner.

## Mac SSH access

The Mac private key stays at `~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb`. Its public key is
stored in the repository Actions secret `AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY`. The issue
commented by the workflow contains a directly usable command such as:

```sh
ssh -i ~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb -p <port> runner@<run-name>.agentsweb.space
```

The command works only while the corresponding Actions job is running.

## Connecting to a live OpenCode worker

Use the repository helper to discover the worker host and port from the broker
or issue comment. It uses the persistent local key `~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb`:

```sh
bash scripts/ssh-run-log.sh <run-id> --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub
```

For an interactive shell, reuse the host and port printed by the helper and
use the same key:

```sh
ssh -tt -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no \
  -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null \
  -i ~/.ssh/aiplay-agentsweb \
  -p <port> runner@<run-name>.agentsweb.space
```

Do not substitute the generated runner key under `sshworker/outputs/keys/`; it
can produce a misleading `Permission denied (publickey)` result. Temporary
worker SSH access ends when the Actions job and session are cleaned up. Never

## Objective
- Build the full playable game “LA ESPADA CELESTIAL” from an empty browser project: an original Spanish-language, landscape-oriented Android-friendly action RPG with exploration, combat, creature collection, customization, story, three regions, and GOTY-level polish ambition.

## Requirements
- Platform: browser game, priority Android, horizontal orientation, Spanish from Spain.
- Real playable game — no mockup, design bible, decorative buttons, or false GOTY claims.
- Include: Valdoria, Drakmor, Kansordore; Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, color, clothes, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats with measurable effects; equipment changes appearance.
- Real-time combat with attacks, dodge, block, animations; creature taming/collection; equipment, levels, quests, dialogue choices, bosses, save/load.
- Mobile touch controls, responsive layouts, safe areas; procedural/original art, music, SFX; accessibility and performance.
- Use actual platform capabilities and explain limitations with best alternatives.

## Decisions
- Built as dependency-free HTML5 Canvas 2D RPG (DOM overlays for UI) to maximize reliability on Android browsers and avoid asset licensing issues.
- Procedural vector art and Web Audio synthesis for original visuals/audio.
- Single-page world with three generated region maps and scene transitions.
- Story structure: Act I Valdoria, Act II Drakmor, Act III Kansordore, three possible endings including secret ending.
- Combat: 3-hit combo, dodge i-frames, block/perfect block, three abilities, companion auto-attacks/active ability, boss phases.
- Creature taming via timing mini-game when enemy HP below 32%.
- Keep source plain ES modules with no build step; project has no `package.json`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected empty repository and runtime environment.
- Created `index.html` with title screen, HUD, character creation, overlays, dialogue, resonance minigame, cutscenes, rotate warning.
- Created full responsive cinematic CSS in `styles.css`.
- Implemented core utilities, keyboard/touch input, procedural Web Audio engine.
- Implemented item/equipment data, creature data (12 creatures), enemy data (16 enemies incl. bosses), and story/quests/dialogues/cutscenes.
- Implemented three region generators with terrain, props, buildings, NPCs, spawners, pickups, shrines, stones, triggers, collision.
- Implemented terrain chunk rendering and all environment/building prop art.
- Implemented character/NPC/player/enemy/boss/creature art, portraits.
- Implemented Player systems, Enemy AI, projectiles, SwordWave, Companion.
- Multiple syntax checks passed for JS files written so far.
- Region generation smoke test passed: Valdoria 570 props/7 buildings/7 NPCs/11 spawners/13 pickups; Drakmor 436/9/3/9/12; Kansordore 312/5/3/8/12.

### Active
- Building gameplay orchestration: game loop, world rendering, camera, effects/particles, interactions, quest progression, save/load, UI controller, dialogue runner, resonance flow, endings.
- `src/main.js` does not exist yet — game currently cannot boot.
- HUD references buttons/assets not fully wired.
- Block control not yet exposed in HUD/touch; keyboard mapping currently lacks block key.
- Player queued combo handling needs verification/fix.
- NPC dialogue file was fixed for malformed `ren`/`mira` cases; syntax passes.

### Blocked
- None currently.

## Next Move
1. Create `src/game/effects.js`: particles, floating text, slashes, rings, telegraphs, beams, hazards, dash trails, boss phase effects.
2. Create `src/game/camera.js` with smooth follow, shake, world-to-screen.
3. Create `src/game/game.js`: load region, player spawn, loop, update/render, sorting, interactions, quest events, spawners, save/load, travel, boss triggers, combat handlers (`playerMeleeHit`, `spawnSlash`, `spawnSwordWave`, `spawnPulse`, `veilStep`, `aimAngleFor`, `burst`, `floatingText`, etc.).
4. Create `src/ui/ui.js`: HUD updates, menus (equipment, inventory, creatures, quests, map, settings, save), shop, shrine/fast travel, dialogue typewriter/choices, resonance ring, cutscenes, endings, toasts, portrait/canvas rendering.
5. Create `src/main.js` bootstrapping title/creation/game, audio unlock, local save slots, fatal error handling.
6. Add block key/touch control and journal key label correction (`Tab`, not J).
7. Start local server (`PORT=3000 bash start.sh` or custom static server) and verify with `playwright-cli` screenshots; inspect images, fix visual/gameplay bugs, test mobile viewport.
8. Add tests or smoke automation if time permits; finalize README/game instructions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: complete DOM shell for title, HUD, creation, menus, dialogue, resonance, cutscenes.
- `styles.css`: full visual design/responsive/touch styling; contains placeholder `--cut-bg-*` CSS variables not yet defined.
- `src/core/utils.js`: math/noise/color helpers.
- `src/core/input.js`: keyboard/touch joystick/action mapping.
- `src/core/audio.js`: procedural music themes and SFX.
- `src/data/items.js`: items, equipment, stats, starting kits.
- `src/data/creatures.js`: 12 creatures, passives/abilities.
- `src/data/enemies.js`: enemy/boss definitions and stats.
- `src/data/story.js`: quests, NPCs, dialogue trees, cutscenes, endings.
- `src/world/regions.js`: three region maps, TILE=48, collision, `getRegion`, `canStand`, terrain enums.
- `src/art/terrain.js`: chunk terrain renderer and animated water/lava/void.
- `src/art/props.js`: trees, buildings, shrines, stones, environment details.
- `src/art/characters.js`: player/NPC/enemy/boss/creature drawing and portraits.
- `src/game/player.js`: stats, equipment, inventory, movement, combat, abilities, XP.
- `src/game/entities.js`: Enemy AI/boss attacks, Projectile, SwordWave, Companion.

## Important Context
- Working directory: `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`; git repo currently uncommitted/untracked changes.

- `Player` expects profile `{name, look, attributes, kit}`; starting kits `errante`, `guardia`, `erudito`.
- Region IDs: `valdoria`, `drakmor`, `kansordore`; expected spawn points exist in region `.startSpawn`.
- Story actions to implement in game/UI: `startQuest:id`, `advance:id`, `completeQuest:id`, `setFlag:name`, `travel:region:spawn`, `shop:vendor`, `buy:item:price`, `giveItem`/`gold`, `creature:id`, `cutscene:name`, `ending`.
- Quest events: `talk`, `kill`, `collect`, `reach`, `boss`, `flag`; main quests `m1`→`m6`; side quests `s_*`.
- Use `playwright-cli` from Actions environment; server should run on port 3000 or 3002, keep persistent via tmux if long-lived.

## Objective
- Build the full playable browser game “LA ESPADA CELESTIAL”: an original Spanish-language, landscape-oriented, Android-friendly action RPG with exploration, combat, creature collection, customization, story, three regions, and GOTY-level polish ambition.

## Requirements
- Browser game, Android priority, horizontal orientation, Spanish from Spain.
- Real playable game — no mockup, design bible, decorative buttons, or false GOTY claims.
- Include: Valdoria, Drakmor, Kansordore; Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, color, clothes, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats with measurable effects; equipment changes appearance.
- Real-time combat with attacks, dodge, block, animations; creature taming/collection; equipment, levels, quests, dialogue choices, bosses, save/load.
- Mobile touch controls, responsive layouts, safe areas; procedural/original art, music, SFX; accessibility and performance.
- Use actual platform capabilities and explain limitations with best alternatives.

## Decisions
- Built as dependency-free HTML5 Canvas 2D RPG (DOM overlays for UI) to maximize reliability on Android browsers and avoid asset licensing issues.
- Procedural vector art and Web Audio synthesis for original visuals/audio.
- Single-page world with three generated region maps and scene transitions.
- Story structure: Act I Valdoria, Act II Drakmor, Act III Kansordore, three possible endings including secret ending.
- Combat: 3-hit combo, dodge i-frames, block/perfect block, three abilities, companion auto-attacks/active ability, boss phases.
- Creature taming via timing mini-game when enemy HP below 32%.
- Keep source plain ES modules with no build step; project has no `package.json`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Repository/runtime inspected; no longer empty.
- `index.html` complete DOM shell for title, HUD, creation, overlays, dialogue, resonance, cutscenes, rotate warning.
- `styles.css` complete responsive cinematic styling; still lacks definitions for placeholder `--cut-bg-*` CSS variables.
- Core utilities, keyboard/touch input, procedural Web Audio engine completed.
- Item/equipment data, 12 creatures, 16 enemies incl. bosses, story/quests/dialogues/cutscenes completed.
- Three region generators with terrain, props, buildings, NPCs, spawners, pickups, shrines, stones, triggers, collision completed; smoke test passed.
- Terrain chunk renderer and all environment/building prop art completed.
- Character/NPC/player/enemy/boss/creature art and portraits completed.
- `src/game/player.js` systems, `src/game/entities.js` enemy AI/projectiles/companions completed.
- Created `src/game/effects.js`: particles, floating text, slashes, rings, telegraphs, ground spikes, hazard pools, light beams, dash trails, boss phase effects.
- Created `src/game/camera.js`: smooth follow, shake, world clamping, screen/world transforms.
- Created `src/game/game.js`: region loading, loop, world/weather/atmosphere rendering, interactions, quests/flags, save/load, travel, spawners, bosses, combat callbacks, resonance, shrines, deaths, finale/endings.
- Created `src/core/save.js`: localStorage save slots, settings persistence, save metadata/time formatting.
- Created `src/ui/ui.js`: HUD, minimap, quest/equipment/inventory/creatures/map/save/settings menus, shops, shrine menu, dialogue typewriter/choices/actions, resonance ring, cutscenes, death/finale/ending screens, character-creation UI.
- `src/main.js` does not exist yet — game still cannot boot.
- Creation preview/stat allocation/gear selection implemented, but not yet wired to boot flow.
- Block and mouse controls partially implemented in game/UI but not yet reflected in `index.html` HUD, touch controls, keymap, or hint text.
- Player queued combo handling still not fixed.
- `game.js` has minor cleanup issues: unused labeled block `int: {}` in `completeQuest`; boss spawn state is persisted into `regionState.bosses` in a way that can prevent respawn after reload.

### Active
- Wire the entire game boot flow: title screen, continue/new game, creation, intro cutscene, HUD, start loop.
- Add block control (`KeyQ` or equivalent) to keymap, HUD ability bar, touch controls, and desktop hints; fix journal hint (`Tab`, not `J`).
- Add missing CSS vars (`--cut-bg-1` … `--cut-bg-12`), HUD gold styling, block button styling, creation/mobile polish.
- Fix Player queued combo continuation and review game boss-state persistence.
- Start a static server and verify with `playwright-cli` screenshots at desktop and mobile landscape sizes; test actual gameplay, combat, dialogue, menus, save/load, region travel, finale.

### Blocked
- None currently.

## Next Move
1. Create `src/main.js`:
   - Bootstrap fatal-error overlay and loading.
   - Instantiate `Input`, `AudioEngine`, `UIController`, apply saved settings.
   - Bind title buttons: Continue (latest save), New Game (`ui.openCreation()`), Settings (`ui.openSettingsStandalone()`).
   - Animate title background using Valdoria terrain/props.
   - On creation begin, build profile, create armor override from `armorPick`, construct `Game`, start it, show intro cutscene, start loop.
   - Wire `ui.onNewGame`, `ui.onLoadSave`, `ui.onExitToTitle`, `ui.onSettingsChange`.
   - Handle audio unlock on first gesture and responsive DPR.
2. Patch `index.html`/`styles.css` for block button, gold display, correct keys, touch layout, and cutscene gradients.
3. Patch `src/core/input.js` to add block key/action and any mouse support needed.
4. Patch `src/game/player.js` queued combo handling.
5. Clean `src/game/game.js` issues (`int:` label; boss persistence; ensure `ui.refreshHud`/`refresh` naming consistent).
6. Run syntax checks on all JS, then static server on port 3000/3002 and use `playwright-cli` to inspect/verify/fix.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: DOM shell and IDs used by all UI/game wiring.
- `styles.css`: full styling; needs cutscene background vars and small additions.
- `src/main.js`: missing boot entrypoint; highest priority.
- `src/ui/ui.js`: all UI/menu/dialogue/cutscene/creation logic and callbacks.
- `src/game/game.js`: core orchestration, combat, quests, save/travel, rendering.
- `src/game/player.js`: player stats/combat/movement/equipment; queued combo needs fix.
- `src/game/entities.js`: enemy/boss AI, projectiles, companion.
- `src/game/effects.js`: combat effects API used by entities/player/game.
- `src/game/camera.js`: camera follow/shake transforms.
- `src/world/regions.js`: generated maps, collision, spawn points, triggers.
- `src/data/story.js`: quests, NPCs, dialogue trees, cutscenes, endings.
- `src/data/items.js`: items, equipment, kits, stat definitions.
- `src/data/creatures.js`: 12 creatures, passives, abilities.
- `src/data/enemies.js`: enemies/bosses and boss intros.
- `src/core/save.js`: save slots, settings, localStorage helpers.

## Important Context
- Working directory: `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`; git repo has uncommitted/untracked changes.
- No `package.json`; use a simple static server (`PORT=3000 bash start.sh` or equivalent) for browser verification.
- `src/main.js` missing means the game cannot boot yet.
- `Game` expects UI methods including `isBlocking`, `refreshHud`, `setBoss`, `bossIntro`, `showZone`, `setInteraction`, `startDialogue`, `openShrine`, `openResonance`, `playCutscene`, `showFinale`, `showEnding`, `showDeath`, `toast`, `openMenu`, `closeAll`, `tick`.
- `Player` expects profile `{name, look, attributes, kit}`; starting kits `errante`, `guardia`, `erudito`.
- Region IDs: `valdoria`, `drakmor`, `kansordore`; expected spawn points exist in region `.startSpawn`.
- Story actions implemented in UI/game: `startQuest:id`, `advance:id`, `completeQuest:id`, `setFlag:name`, `travel:region:spawn`, `shop:vendor`, `buy:item:price`, `giveItem`, `gold`, `creature:id`, `cutscene:name`, `ending`, `close`.
- Quest events: `talk`, `kill`, `collect`, `reach`, `boss`, `flag`; main quests `m1`→`m6`; side quests `s_*`.
- In-game talk quest events intentionally fire in the dialogue close callback (`handleEvent('talk', npcId)`) to avoid double-advancing scripted dialogue actions.
- Secret ending gates on flags `eco_uno`/`eco_dos`/`eco_tres` plus at least 3 tamed creatures.
- Need to test that `drawStones`, `drawEnvironment`, and entity sorting render acceptably; current implementation draws entities on top of all props.

  if (!l2) return Math.hypot(px - x1, py - y1);
  let t = ((px - x1) * dx + (py - y1) * dy) / l2;
  t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
  return Math.hypot(px - (x1 + t * dx), py - (y1 + t * dy));
}

## Objective
- Build the full playable browser game “LA ESPADA CELESTIAL”: an original Spanish-language, landscape-oriented, Android-friendly action RPG with exploration, combat, creature collection, customization, story, three regions, and GOTY-level polish ambition.

## Requirements
- Browser game, Android priority, horizontal orientation, Spanish from Spain.
- Real playable game — no mockup, design bible, decorative buttons, or false GOTY claims.
- Include: Valdoria, Drakmor, Kansordore; Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, color, clothes, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats with measurable effects; equipment changes appearance.
- Real-time combat with attacks, dodge, block, animations; creature taming/collection; equipment, levels, quests, dialogue choices, bosses, save/load.
- Mobile touch controls, responsive layouts, safe areas; procedural/original art, music, SFX; accessibility and performance.
- Use actual platform capabilities and explain limitations with best alternatives.

## Decisions
- Built as dependency-free HTML5 Canvas 2D RPG (DOM overlays for UI) to maximize reliability on Android browsers and avoid asset licensing issues.
- Procedural vector art and Web Audio synthesis for original visuals/audio.
- Single-page world with three generated region maps and scene transitions.
- Story structure: Act I Valdoria, Act II Drakmor, Act III Kansordore, three possible endings including secret ending.
- Combat: 3-hit combo, dodge i-frames, block/perfect block, three abilities, companion auto-attacks/active ability, boss phases.
- Creature taming via timing mini-game when enemy HP below 32%.
- Keep source plain ES modules with no build step; project has no `package.json`.
- Added a title-background loop using the actual generated Valdoria map, plus a boot loader/fatal overlay.
- Exposed `window.__LEC` (`game`, `ui`, `audio`, `input`, `settings`) for browser diagnostics.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html`, `styles.css`, all data/art/world/core/game/UI modules exist and pass `node --check`.
- Created missing `src/main.js`: boot flow, title backdrop, title/continue/new/settings wiring, creation → intro cutscene → gameplay, save loading, exit-to-title, audio unlock, DPR/resize handling, fatal overlay, diagnostics.
- Implemented creation bindings in `src/ui/ui.js`: tabs, dots/step label, option buttons, name input, back, begin, control resync, `updateCreationPreview()`, `refresh()` alias.
- Added HUD gold chip, block key `Q`, block ability/touch buttons, shield icon, correct journal hint `Tab`, boot overlay, favicon, and missing `creation-screen` class.
- Added all 12 `--cut-bg-*` gradients and gold/guard/boot/touch styling.
- Fixed UI null crashes (`quest-kicker` id, HUD/minimap region guards).
- Fixed player queued combo continuation and `a.comboIndex` cooldown bug.
- Fixed `game.particles` → `game.effects` in `entities.js`/`effects.js`.
- Removed `int:` label in `completeQuest`; boss state no longer persists in `regionState.bosses`.
- Wrapped game loop update/render in try/catch so a runtime error cannot permanently freeze the game.
- Verified title, creation, stats, intro cutscene, gameplay, movement, combat, well narration, and Nara dialogue in Chromium with screenshots.
- No runtime errors remain except a stale historical log entry; latest runs have no new JS errors.

### Active
- Fix dialogue/NPC portrait framing in `drawPortrait` (`src/art/characters.js`): portraits currently render the body but crop the head because humanoid is drawn at `h * 1.13` with `scale = w / 34`; intended change is roughly `y = h * 1.65` for a visible bust.
- Complete broader browser verification: journal/menus, save/load, region travel, shops, resonance, bosses/endings, mobile landscape layout/touch controls.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Patch `drawPortrait` framing and verify NPC portraits (Nara et al.) plus HUD portrait.
2. Test all menus via `Tab`/settings/journal: equipment, inventory, creatures, map, save/load, shops, shrine travel.
3. Test mobile landscape at e.g. 844×390 / 740×360; confirm safe areas, touch joystick, attack/dodge/guard/abilities, no HUD overlap.
4. Test combat fully: enemy damage/kill/XP, abilities, perfect block, taming resonance, boss spawn/respawn after save-load.
5. Test region travel and story progression using debug teleport/`travel`, including cutscenes and finale/endings.
6. Add any missing interaction hints/feedback found during testing and re-run syntax checks + screenshots.
7. Clean up temporary screenshots or commit only intended source files.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: boot flow, title/continue/new game, intro cutscene, diagnostics, lifecycle.
- `src/ui/ui.js`: HUD, menus, dialogue, creation, resonance, cutscenes, endings.
- `src/art/characters.js`: `drawPortrait` framing bug; player/NPC/enemy/creature art.

- `src/game/player.js`: stats, equipment, combat, queued combo.
- `src/game/entities.js`: enemy AI, projectiles, companion; effect calls fixed.

- `src/world/regions.js`: generated regions, spawns, NPCs, triggers.
- `screenshots/`: verification captures (`title-desktop.png`, `creation-desktop2.png`, `intro3.png`, `game-start.png`, `combat2.png`, `dialogue-nara2.png`).

"LA ESPADA CELESTIAL
ENCARGO MAESTRO DEFINITIVO PARA IA GAME LAB
RPG DE FANTASÍA ÉPICA — OBJETIVO: ASPIRAR A GOTY
INSTRUCCIÓN PRINCIPAL:
Quiero que desarrolles LA ESPADA CELESTIAL, un videojuego RPG de fantasía medieval, acción, aventura, exploración y criaturas coleccionables. No quiero una simple demostración, una maqueta, una presentación, una biblia de diseño ni un escenario con botones decorativos. Quiero un videojuego real, jugable, funcional, profundo, original y profesional.
La ambición es crear un título capaz de competir algún día entre los mejores videojuegos del mundo y aspirar al premio GOTY (Game of the Year).
No afirmes que el juego ha ganado o merece un premio sin haberlo conseguido. El GOTY es nuestro objetivo de excelencia, no una promesa.
Debes trabajar sobre las capacidades reales de IA Game Lab, inspeccionar el proyecto existente y utilizar las herramientas disponibles para construir el juego. No inventes funciones que la plataforma no pueda ejecutar. Si algo no es posible, explica la limitación y desarrolla la mejor alternativa técnica.
---
1. IDENTIDAD DEL VIDEOJUEGO
Nombre: LA ESPADA CELESTIAL.
Género: RPG de acción, fantasía medieval, aventura, exploración, combate y colección de criaturas.
Plataforma prioritaria: Android.
Orientación: Horizontal.
Idioma: Español de España.
Estética: Fantasía medieval cinematográfica con personalidad anime, escenarios detallados, iluminación espectacular, personajes originales y efectos visuales de alta calidad.
Inspiración: La profundidad de los grandes RPG, la libertad de exploración de las aventuras clásicas y la emoción de coleccionar criaturas, sin copiar personajes, diseños, música, historias ni propiedades intelectuales existentes.
El juego debe tener identidad propia y ser reconocible por su universo, personajes, criaturas, música y dirección artística.
---
2. OBJETIVO DE CALIDAD: NIVEL GOTY
Diseña y desarrolla el juego siguiendo estándares de excelencia en:
Jugabilidad.
Combate.
Historia.
Personajes.
Mundo.
Exploración.
Diseño artístico.
Música y sonido.
Animaciones.
Inteligencia artificial.
Interfaz y controles.
Rendimiento.
Accesibilidad.
Profundidad de sistemas.
Originalidad.
Cada sistema debe aportar algo al conjunto.
No quiero cantidad sin calidad.
No quiero un mundo enorme vacío, enemigos repetidos, misiones genéricas ni habilidades que no tengan utilidad.
Quiero una experiencia memorable.
---
3. UNIVERSO E HISTORIA
El mundo está formado por regiones conectadas por una historia épica.
Región inicial: VALDORIA
Una tierra de aldeas, bosques, praderas, ríos, montañas, ruinas y antiguas civilizaciones.
Aquí comienza la aventura.
Región de DRAKMOR
Territorios volcánicos, fortalezas, ciudades devastadas, bosques oscuros y criaturas corrompidas.
Región de KANSORDORE
Templos celestiales, ciudades antiguas, bibliotecas prohibidas, dimensiones alternativas y misterios relacionados con el origen del mundo.
Elementos fundamentales de la historia
La Gema Celestial.
La Jarra de Origen.
La Lágrima de la Primera Brasa.
La Profecía de Jugador Cero.
La Convergencia Absoluta.
El Despertar.
La Resonancia.
El Velo.
La Ruptura.
La Ascensión.
Construye una historia original, coherente y emocionante, con misterios, revelaciones, conflictos, decisiones, consecuencias, personajes memorables y un final satisfactorio.
No reveles todos los misterios al principio.
La historia debe desarrollarse mediante acontecimientos jugables, diálogos, exploración y escenas cinematográficas.
---
4. PROTAGONISTA
Crear un protagonista personalizable.
Permitir configurar, según las posibilidades técnicas:
Nombre.
Rostro.
Pelo.
Color de pelo.
Ropa.
Armadura.
Casco.
Accesorios.
Armas.
Estadísticas
Vida.
Maná.
Resistencia.
Fuerza.
Defensa.
Velocidad.
Inteligencia.
Suerte.
Cada atributo debe tener efectos medibles.
El equipamiento debe modificar las estadísticas y, cuando sea viable, la apariencia del personaje.
Crear animaciones diferenciadas de reposo, caminar, correr, atacar, esquivar, bloquear, recibi
"
